en.headline: India by the Bay festival opens at Asia Society Hong Kong Center
en.dek: The 11th edition runs from today to 29 November with music, dance, literature and cuisine programmes co-presented by Teamwork Arts and the Asia Society.
body: The India by the Bay festival opened today at the Asia Society Hong Kong Center in Admiralty for its 11th edition, running until 29 November.

Co-presented by Teamwork Arts and the Asia Society Hong Kong Center, the four-day programme includes classical music recitals, dance performances, author conversations, film and cinema discussions, and showcases of Indian cuisine and craft.
Organisers said the festival has grown over the past decade into a regular part of Hong Kong’s cultural calendar, bringing together performers, writers and thinkers from India with local audiences.
Tickets for individual events range from HK$100 to HK$1,500, with details available through the Asia Society Hong Kong Center.

zh.headline: 印度海灣節於亞洲協會香港中心開幕
zh.dek: 第十一屆由今日起至11月29日舉行，包括音樂、舞蹈、文學及美食節目，由Teamwork Arts與亞洲協會合辦。
body: 印度海灣節今日於金鐘亞洲協會香港中心開幕，為第十一屆，活動持續至11月29日。
由Teamwork Arts與亞洲協會香港中心合辦，四日節目涵蓋古典音樂演奏、舞蹈表演、作家對談、電影討論，以及印度美食與工藝展示。
主辦方表示，過去十年該節慶已成為香港文化日程的一部分，將印度表演者、作家及思想家帶到本地觀眾面前。
個別活動票價由100港元至1,500港元，詳情可向亞洲協會香港中心查詢。
